description: CITTA METROPOLITANA MILANO - Dati traffico Luglio Agosto Settembre is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Lombardia. Dal 2015 è stato posto in opera su alcune strade gestite dalla Città Metropolitana di Milano un sistema di accertamento delle infrazioni (in particolare il superamento dei limiti di velocità) i cui dispositivi rimangono in funzione 7 giorni su 7 H-24. Coverage: Regione Lombardia. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Lombardia. Its tags are provincia-di-milano, strade, traffico. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, RDF, TSV, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
